# Bagrat Motors

> Bagrat Motors is an umbrella roadside- and site-services company in Tbilisi, Georgia, operating 24/7 across the whole country. Three service lines: tow truck / evacuator (towing), mobile tyre vulcanization, and mini-excavator work (excavation, sewerage, water supply, pipe welding, post-hole drilling). Founder/director: Bagrat Giorgadze.

## Contact
- [Call 514 90 80 90](tel:+995514908090) — main line (towing & excavator)
- [WhatsApp](https://wa.me/995514908090)
- [Call 591 90 90 13](tel:+995591909013) — vulcanization line
- [Email info@bagratmotors.ge](mailto:info@bagratmotors.ge)
- Location: Tbilisi, Georgia. Hours: 24/7, every day. Towing area: all Georgia.

## Main services
- [Towing / evacuator](https://bagratmotors.ge/en/services/towing/): 24/7 tow-truck call-out in Tbilisi and across Georgia, spider tow, accident & breakdown transport, jump start, fuel delivery, lockout.
- [Mobile tyre service (vulcanization)](https://bagratmotors.ge/en/services/vulcanization/): on-site tyre repair, rim welding, rim straightening, wheel balancing, tyre fitting, battery, jump start.
- [Mini-excavator](https://bagratmotors.ge/en/services/mini-excavator/): digging/excavation, trenches, foundation, site levelling, sewerage, water-supply installation, post-hole drilling, pipe welding, demolition, landscaping.
